key_insight: In asynchronous LLM RL, correcting stale policies alone is not enough because stale advantage estimates also bias training, so policy-side and advantage-side corrections must be coordinated.
engineering_relevance: COPC gives a practical way to keep asynchronous post-training fast while improving stability and final quality, making it attractive for scalable tool-use and reasoning systems.
method: Token-level ratio masking to reduce policy mismatch from stale rollouts.
Two-sided clipped-ratio weighting for TD residuals to correct return and advantage estimation.
Joint actor-critic correction designed to account for interaction between policy-weight error and advantage staleness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that COPC was tested across staleness levels and achieved the strongest reported results on tool-integrated mathematical reasoning and search, while remaining stable even at 64-step policy staleness.
watch_item: Performance depends on coupling between correction hyperparameters, so tuning may be sensitive and implementation must manage the added complexity of coordinated actor-critic weighting.
paper_title: COPC: Coupled Off-Policy Correction for Asynchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
